checked_claims.note: Dimension 3g-3+n=21 for (g,n)=(6,6) is correct; smoothness of the DM stack is standard.

The identification W_k H^k(X;Q)=im(H^k(\bar X;Q)->H^k(X;Q)) is the standard lowest-weight edge statement for a smooth open with smooth proper snc compactification (Q coefficients). Stack versus coarse is not load-bearing here. This step alone does not force Tate type.

Load-bearing failure. The argument renames the restriction image im(H^{26}(\overline M_{6,6})->H^{26}(M_{6,6})) as a codimension-13 stable-graph complex generated by algebraic cotangent and gluing-stratum classes of type Q(-13). That identification is not proved: H^{26} of the compactification is not a priori algebraic or of pure type (13,13), restriction can retain non-(13,13) pure weight-26 summands, and a decorated stable-graph/Gysin complex is not shown to compute this lowest-weight edge image (and is easily confused with top-weight dual-complex graph cohomology). Subquotients of an unestablished pure-Tate complex cannot conclude Tate type.

Poincare duality W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}≅W_{26}H^{26}(21) and the arithmetic Q(-13)(21)=Q(8) match the fixed target dictionary, but the Tate conclusion inherits the refutation of C3. No independent control of non-Tate summands is given.

finding_candidates.statement: For M_{6,6}, the pure piece W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)=im(H^{26}(\overline M_{6,6};Q)->H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)) is not identified by any supplied argument with a codimension-13 decorated stable-graph complex generated by algebraic cotangent and gluing classes; treating that image as a subquotient of such a complex is circular and does not rule out surviving non-Tate pure weight-26 summands.

A class in H^{26}(\overline M_{6,6};Q) need not be an algebraic cycle of codimension 13; equating ordinary degree 26 with Chow codimension 13 and concluding type Q(-13) upgrades a pure-Tate/algebraicity prediction to an unconditional theorem without controlling Hodge numbers h^{p,26-p} for p≠13 or non-algebraic (13,13) phenomena beyond MHS type.

Any complete attack on the exact lowest-weight target for (g,n)=(6,6) must still confront the packet residual geometry (balanced tetragonal splitting, W_5 failure locus Z, h^0 stratification, components/stabilizers); ATT-0020 omits all stable-pair and evaluation-failure analysis and therefore cannot certify absence of a surviving non-Tate summand.

If boundary contributions are organized by stable graphs, the passage between stacky strata, coarse moduli, and Aut(Γ)-invariants versus coinvariants (with Q coefficients) must be stated; ATT-0020 writes an alternating Gysin complex with no automorphism bookkeeping, so even a corrected strata spectral sequence would be incomplete.

proof_dependency_checks.note: ATT-0020 declares proof_dependencies as an empty array; no undischarged dependency ids to verify.

scope_checks: stack versus coarse space: Q-coefficient DM-stack cohomology is invoked without coarse comparison; not the fatal step
rational versus integral coefficients: argument is over Q; no integral claim
cohomology versus Borel-Moore degree: PD pairs H^{26} with H^{BM}_{16} and weight 26 with weight -16; dictionary matches, but depends on C3
Poincare duality and Tate twists: twist by dim=21 sends Q(-13) to Q(8); arithmetic ok, source of Q(-13) fails
Gysin and Kunneth shifts: asserted only as algebraic morphisms of Tate structures; no stratum-by-stratum shift table
degeneration or spectral-sequence differentials: weight edge-image used; no control of which classes in H^{26}(\overline M) die under restriction or of Gysin SS differentials
invariants versus coinvariants under graph automorphisms: omitted
semisimplification versus actual Hodge-structure isomorphism: claims actual direct sum of Q(-13)/Q(8), not merely gr or ss
predicted motives used as unconditional theorems: algebraic stable-graph generators of type Q(-13) used as if theorem
pure Tate silently upgraded to algebraic or tautological generation: explicit upgrade from degree 26 to codim-13 algebraic cycles
omitted stable pairs: entire Z/tetragonal residual geometry omitted
strongest_attack: C3 silently upgrades the lowest-weight edge image im(H^{26}(\overline M_{6,6};Q)->H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)) to a codimension-13 algebraic stable-graph complex of pure type Q(-13): cohomological degree 26 is treated as cycle codimension 13, non-(13,13) summands of pure H^{26}(\overline M_{6,6}) are declared impossible without a vanishing argument, Gysin/Kunneth/Aut(Γ) shifts on actual strata are not tracked, and the packet's residual tetragonal failure locus is never analyzed—so the claimed pure-Tate isomorphism is circular relative to the theorem.
theorem_statement: The exact group W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q), equivalently W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)(21), is a direct sum of Q(8); a disproof must exhibit a surviving non-Tate summand in this exact group.
